acip: GANG GI TSE BDAG MA 'ONGS PA'I DUS NA BLA NA MED PA YANG DAG PAR RDZOGS PA'I BYANG CHUB MNGON PAR RDZOGS PAR SANGS RGYAS PA DE NA SEMS CAN GANG DAG 'DOD CHAGS DANG, ZHE SDANG DANG, GTI MUG GIS BSGRIBS PA,
wylie: gang gi tshe bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de na sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang, zhe sdang dang, gti mug gis bsgribs pa
english: In future days, when I reach total enlightenment—when I reach my own matchless, perfect, and complete Buddhahood—there will be certain beings whose minds are clouded by ignorant liking, and ignorant disliking, and by dark ignorance itself.
